description: This Java source file defines the 'HibernateSessionFactoryBean' class, which extends Spring's LocalSessionFactoryBean to configure and manage Hibernate SessionFactory within the OpenMRS framework. It includes logic for loading Hibernate properties, integrating module-specific mappings, and setting interceptors for Hibernate sessions.

classes.name: HibernateSessionFactoryBean
classes.description: Custom Hibernate SessionFactory bean for OpenMRS with module integration and property loading.

methods.description: Adds package names for scanning annotated Hibernate entities.

methods.name: getModuleMappingResources
methods.description: Retrieves mapping resources from all started modules.

methods.name: getModulePackagesWithMappedClasses
methods.description: Retrieves packages with mapped classes from all modules.
